newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cops jailed for helping with narco wedding.
newsitem.headline: Cops jailed for helping with narco wedding.

text.p: Mexican police have arrested 10 policemen who allegedly worked for a drug lord and served as protection for his family at a wedding earlier this year, authorities said on Wednesday.
Police arrested the men on Tuesday, months after a botched attempt by police and the army to arrest the drug lord, Amado Carrillo Fuentes, at the January wedding.
Carrillo reportedly attended the wedding, but a warning allowed him to escape before police arrived.
The Attorney General's office said in a statement the men all worked as local police in the town of Navolato, in the northeastern state of Sinaloa, where the wedding was held
